comment: Lidar roof-form pilot (data, not code). Area = a committed P2 test area (read-only); the profile is the one P2 uses for it (BuildingAreaTests, p2_gate_shots.sh). Lidar = USGS 3DEP Entwine Point Tiles in the public usgs-lidar-public bucket (not requester-pays); only octree nodes whose horizontal extent meets the area box (plus a margin) are read.

ept.acquired: 2017-04-16 to 2017-05-07 (FGDC metadata of the delivery tile at the area centre)
